mapper.select: select count(1) from smx_expert_like where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into smx_expert_like (user_id, target_type, target_id) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})
mapper.delete: delete from smx_expert_like where user_id = #{userId} and target_type = #{targetType} and target_id = #{targetId}
delete from smx_expert_like where (target_type = '1' and target_id = #{questionId}) or (target_type = '2' and target_id in (select answer_id from smx_expert_answer where question_id = #{questionId}))
delete from smx_expert_like where target_type = '2' and target_id = #{answerId}
